patch_list: Forces Unity IL2CPP access getters (HasThisAppPurchase, IsOwnedSharedActive, offline grants, IsFullAccess, IsActive) to true in lib/arm64-v8a/libil2cpp.so. Required together with Unlock subscription (Java / SharedSub).

Unlocks BB Pass shared subscription on the Java/JNI side and marks Play purchases as owned. Activates local SharedSub state when the game starts. Must be used together with Unlock subscription (IL2CPP native).
